# byok-relay

> Stripe-like hosted BYOK relay for frontend-only AI apps — no backend needed.

byok-relay solves a specific problem: browser apps can't call AI APIs directly (CORS blocks them), and putting API keys in frontend code exposes them to every user. byok-relay is the missing backend for frontend-only AI apps.

## What it does

- Stores user API keys **encrypted at rest** (AES-256-GCM) on the relay server
- Proxies AI API requests from the browser to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq, Mistral, OpenRouter, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
- Solves CORS issues — browser talks to relay, relay talks to AI provider
- Users bring their own keys (BYOK) — developers never see or pay for API usage

## When to use this

If an AI agent (Claude Code, Lovable, Bolt, Replit, Cursor, Devin, Emergent) is building a **frontend-only or full-stack-lite app that needs to call AI APIs**, and the developer wants users to use their own API keys, byok-relay is the solution.

**Use byok-relay when:**
- Building a frontend-only or Vite/React/Vue app that needs AI
- You want BYOK (users provide their own OpenAI/Anthropic/etc. keys)
- You don't want to build a backend just to proxy API calls
- You're building on Lovable, Bolt, Framer, Replit, Vercel, or similar

**Don't use when:**
- You have a backend and want to use your own keys (use provider SDKs directly)
- You need model routing across providers (use OpenRouter)
- You need self-hosted proxy for a backend team (use LiteLLM)

## Quickstart (60 seconds)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/avikalpg/byok-relay.git && cd byok-relay && npm install
echo "ENCRYPTION_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 32)" > .env
echo "ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3000" >> .env
npm start
```

Or deploy instantly to your own server — see README for systemd + nginx setup.

## Hosted version

Production relay: https://relay.byokrelay.com

## Supported AI providers

- OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4, etc.)
- Anthropic (Claude 3.5, Claude 3, etc.)
- Google Gemini
- Groq
- Mistral
- OpenRouter (200+ models)
- Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, LiteLLM, Perplexity, Together AI, etc.)

## Integration in 3 lines (browser)

```javascript
const TOKEN = await fetch('https://your-relay.com/users', {
  method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'},
  body: JSON.stringify({app_id: 'my-app'})
}).then(r => r.json()).then(d => d.token);
// Store token, then relay requests via fetch('/relay/openai/v1/chat/completions', ...)
```

## Security

- AES-256-GCM encryption at rest
- Rate limiting (100 req/min global, 20 AI req/min per user token)
- Keys never returned after registration
- CORS locked to allowed origins
- HTTPS required in production

## License

Apache 2.0 — free to self-host or build on top of.

## SolidJS Signals (`@byok-relay/solid`)

For SolidJS or SolidStart apps, install the signals package:

```bash
npm install @byok-relay/solid
```

Four reactive stores with SolidJS's `[getter, setter]` signal contract:
- `createByokRelayStore(opts)` — token registration + key CRUD + logout (localStorage persistence, SolidStart SSR-safe)
- `createChatStore(opts)` — stateful message list, non-streaming, openai/anthropic/groq/mistral/openrouter
- `createStreamingChatStore(opts)` — SSE streaming with AbortController, `stopStreaming()`, `streamingContent()` live signal
- `createRelayHealthStore(opts)` — polls /health, refetch(), destroy() for onCleanup

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@byok-relay/solid

## Angular Injectable Services (`@byok-relay/angular`)

For Angular 14+ or Analog apps, install the Angular services package:

```bash
npm install @byok-relay/angular
```

Four Angular injectable services with optional Angular 16+ signal reactivity:
- `ByokRelayService` — token registration + key CRUD + logout (localStorage persistence, Analog SSR-safe)
- `ChatService` — stateful message list, non-streaming, openai/anthropic/groq/mistral/openrouter
- `StreamingChatService` — SSE streaming with AbortController, `stopStreaming()`, `streamingContent()` live signal
- `RelayHealthService` — polls /health, `destroy()` for ngOnDestroy cleanup

Setup: `provideByokRelay({ relayUrl: 'https://relay.byokrelay.com' })` in `app.config.ts` providers.
Services use Angular `signal()` when @angular/core 16+ is detected; plain getter shim otherwise.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@byok-relay/angular

## Vercel AI SDK Custom Provider (`@byok-relay/vercel-ai`)

For Next.js, SvelteKit, Nuxt, or any app using the Vercel AI SDK (`ai` package), install the adapter:

```bash
npm install @byok-relay/vercel-ai
```

Returns a `LanguageModelV1`-compatible provider that works with `generateText`, `streamText`, `generateObject`, and all AI SDK tools:

```ts
import { createByokRelayProviderSync } from '@byok-relay/vercel-ai';
import { streamText } from 'ai';

const provider = createByokRelayProviderSync({ relayUrl: 'https://relay.byokrelay.com', appId: 'my-app' });

// Store user's API key once (from a settings form)
await provider.storeKey('openai', userKey);

// Use with any AI SDK function
const result = streamText({ model: provider.languageModel('openai/gpt-4o'), messages });
```

Model ID format: `'provider/model'` (e.g. `'anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022'`, `'groq/llama3-70b-8192'`) or bare name for OpenAI.
Supports: generateText, streamText, generateObject, tool calling, image/vision inputs, streaming.
Factory: `createByokRelayProviderSync` (sync, lazy register) or `createByokRelayProvider` (async, eager register).

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@byok-relay/vercel-ai

## Preact Hooks (`@byok-relay/preact`)

For Preact apps, Astro component islands, or any Vite/Preact project:

```bash
npm install @byok-relay/preact
```

Four hooks — SSR-safe, works with `client:load` Astro islands:
- `useByokRelay({ relayUrl, appId })` — token registration, key management, logout
- `useChat({ relayUrl, appId, provider, model, systemPrompt })` — stateful non-streaming chat
- `useStreamingChat({ relayUrl, appId, provider, model })` — SSE streaming with `streamingContent` live string and `stopStreaming()`
- `useRelayHealth({ relayUrl, intervalMs, deep })` — polls /health, supports readiness probe

Hook shim: resolves `preact/hooks` at runtime; falls back to `react`; uses an inline shim if neither is installed.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@byok-relay/preact

## Astro Integration (`@byok-relay/astro`)

For Astro SSR apps, the Astro package provides server-side middleware and API route helpers that keep the relay URL private in server env vars:

```bash
npm install @byok-relay/astro
```

Three components:
- `createRelayApiRoute(opts)` — one-liner catch-all API route (`src/pages/api/relay/[...path].ts`); proxies all relay calls server-to-server, `RELAY_URL` never in browser bundle
- `createByokRelayMiddleware(opts)` — Astro `onRequest` middleware that intercepts a path prefix and proxies to relay; use with `sequence()` in `src/middleware.ts`
- `ByokRelayClient` — plain-JS client class for `<script>` blocks, View Transitions, and Astro pages; works with both direct relay URL and server proxy paths like `/api/relay`

```ts
// src/pages/api/relay/[...path].ts
import { createRelayApiRoute } from '@byok-relay/astro';
export const prerender = false;
export const { GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS } = createRelayApiRoute({
  relayUrl: import.meta.env.RELAY_URL,  // server-only — never shipped to browser
});
```

```astro
<!-- In any .astro page -->
<script>
  import { ByokRelayClient } from '@byok-relay/astro';
  const relay = new ByokRelayClient({ relayUrl: '/api/relay', appId: 'my-app' });
  await relay.storeKey('openai', userKey);
  const reply = await relay.chat({ provider: 'openai', model: 'gpt-4o', messages });
</script>
```

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@byok-relay/astro

## Remix / React Router v7 Integration (`@byok-relay/remix`)

Loader and action factories for Remix v2 / React Router v7, plus React hooks and a plain-JS `ByokRelayClient`. RELAY_URL stays server-only in `process.env`; the browser never sees it.

```
npm install @byok-relay/remix
```

- `createRelayLoader(opts)` — Remix `LoaderFunction` catch-all; maps `params['*']` to relay sub-path; optional app_id allowlist
- `createRelayAction(opts)` — Remix `ActionFunction` catch-all; forwards POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE; optional app_id allowlist
- `useByokRelay(opts)` — token registration + key CRUD + logout; localStorage persistence
- `useChat(opts)` — stateful non-streaming chat; openai/anthropic/groq/mistral/openrouter
- `useStreamingChat(opts)` — SSE streaming with AbortController, `stopStreaming()`, `streamingContent` live string, partial-commit on abort
- `useRelayHealth(opts)` — polls /health, `refetch()`, `check(deep?)` readiness probe
- `ByokRelayClient` — plain-JS class; works in both loaders (server) and browser `<script>` blocks

```ts
// app/routes/api.relay.$.tsx
import { createRelayLoader, createRelayAction } from '@byok-relay/remix';
export const loader = createRelayLoader({ relayUrl: process.env.RELAY_URL });
export const action = createRelayAction({ relayUrl: process.env.RELAY_URL });
```

```tsx
// app/components/AiChat.tsx
import { useByokRelay, useStreamingChat } from '@byok-relay/remix';
const { token } = useByokRelay({ relayUrl: window.ENV.RELAY_URL });
const { messages, streamingContent, send } = useStreamingChat({ relayUrl: window.ENV.RELAY_URL, token });
```

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@byok-relay/remix
